content.comment_body: Hello all, We ordered a [product_name] starter package [article_no]. Upon receiving it, the DVD for [product_name] was missing, so we downloaded an older version and upgraded to a newer one. We need to provide the updated software to a customer. Is there an official link to download [product_name] V8.3 or newer? Thanks for your assistance.

You can obtain the upgrade for the latest [product_name] version V8.4 online. There are download links available for the [product_name] [article_no]. Check the last post in the discussion for details.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered difficulties obtaining the necessary [product_name] software for their starter package due to a missing installation DVD. They are seeking a direct download link to ensure they can deliver the correct software version to their customer, emphasizing challenges with software access and distribution in starter packages.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates simple access to the latest [product_name] version for deployment and customer delivery, preferably through an official and direct download source.
